Front: Paano gumawa ng protected route component?
Back: function ProtectedRoute({ children }) { const { user } = useAuth(); return user ? children : <Navigate to='/login' />; }

Front: Paano i-wrap ang protected routes sa React Router?

Back: <Navigate to='/login' replace /> — gamitin ang Navigate component mula sa react-router-dom

Front: Paano gumawa ng role-based protected route?
Back: function RoleRoute({ role, children }) { const { user } = useAuth(); return user.role === role ? children : <Navigate to='/unauthorized' />; }
